name: 80230 · Denver, CO
findings: ZIP 80230 (Denver) has 85 nonprofit organizations. 41 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 35 organizations.
Health care organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 80230 (Denver) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 80230 (Denver) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).
